head: working-tree
subject: digest-locked Autobahn WebSocket fuzzingclient gate
scope: strict zig build interop-websocket-autobahn gate using the pinned amd64 Docker image on an amd64 host
notes: The strict report checker verified the exact versioned 25.10.1 manifest: all 517 case IDs, the pinned image digest, the single netz agent, and the expected status baseline. The three non-OK cases are the manifest's allowed close-behavior INFORMATIONAL cases. This run uses the dedicated long-lived zio-std-io echo endpoint with 64 workers and exercises the HTTP/1 Upgrade handshake path, including the 2026-11-08 HTTP/1 parser changes. It supersedes the earlier note that no Docker runtime was available on this host.
